---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for Aginctus
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ""
---

## Summary

Clear and concise description of the proposed feature.

## Motivation

What problem does this solve? Why is it needed?

## Proposed design

Describe how you envision the feature working, including any configuration
options, CLI commands, or documentation changes.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any alternative approaches you considered and why you chose this one.

## Security considerations

Does this change involve sandboxing, network controls, credentials, secrets,
MCP permissions, model access, authentication, authorization, or host
capabilities? If so, describe the security implications.

## Additional context

Links to related issues, PRs, or documentation.
